# Remind

> Remind is a Claude Code plugin that lets you say "remind me to..." and shows what is due in a line above the prompt.

Reminders live in a local list (`~/.claude/remind/reminders.json`) or in your Apple Reminders on a Mac. Claude adds, lists and completes them with three tools: `add_reminder`, `list_reminders` and `complete_reminder`. The `/remind` pane also shows the current folder's git status and, if you set repos, the latest deploys. MIT licensed.

Install, in Claude Code:

```
/plugin install remind --marketplace hg913488/claude-code-reminders
```

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/hg913488/claude-code-reminders/blob/main/README.md): install, how it works, settings, FAQ
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/hg913488/claude-code-reminders/blob/main/AGENTS.md): layout, checks and gotchas for coding agents

- [hooks/register.tsx](https://github.com/hg913488/claude-code-reminders/blob/main/hooks/register.tsx): the whole mod: tools, band, pane

- [.claude-plugin/plugin.json](https://github.com/hg913488/claude-code-reminders/blob/main/.claude-plugin/plugin.json): manifest and settings
